en.headline: Two hikers airlifted after heat illness on hottest day of the year
en.dek: A 28-year-old man near Po Pin Chau in Sai Kung and a seven-year-old girl on the South Lantau Country Trail were rescued by Government Flying Service helicopter on Saturday afternoon as temperatures exceeded 38 degrees…
body: Two hikers were airlifted to hospital after falling ill in the extreme heat on Saturday, Hong Kong’s hottest day of the year so far, with temperatures exceeding 38 degrees Celsius in some areas.

At about 2.30pm, a 28-year-old man surnamed Wen felt unwell while hiking near Po Pin Chau in Sai Kung. Nearby Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department staff alerted police, and a Government Flying Service helicopter airlifted him to Ruttonjee Hospital.

About an hour later, a seven-year-old girl hiking with a group of eight family members on the South Lantau Country Trail began feeling tired and nauseous. Family members called for help, and she was also airlifted to Ruttonjee Hospital. Upon arrival, her family declined further medical treatment and left.

Sheung Shui recorded 38.5 degrees shortly before 2pm, while several other stations exceeded 37 degrees. The Hong Kong Observatory had the Very Hot Weather Warning in force amid the influence of Severe Typhoon Dolphin’s outer subsiding air.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣兩名行山者疑中暑 直升機救出包括7歲女童
zh.dek: 周六本港極端酷熱，新界部分地區氣溫超過38度，西貢破邊洲一名28歲男子及南大嶼山一名7歲女童先後懷疑中暑，由飛行服務隊直升機送往律敦治醫院。
body: 本港周六錄得今年最高氣溫，部分地區超過38度，下午多處有行山人士懷疑中暑，包括一名7歲女童。
下午約2時半，西貢破邊洲一名28歲姓文內地男子行山時頭暈不適，懷疑中暑，附近漁護署職員報警，飛行服務隊直升機將他救出，送往律敦治醫院治理。
約一小時後，一名7歲女童與家人共八人在南大嶼山行山時出現疲倦及想嘔徵狀，同行家人報警，同樣由直升機送往律敦治醫院。到院後家人拒絕就醫並離開。
上水下午近2時錄得38.5度，新界多區超過37度。天文台當時正發出酷熱天氣警告，受強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響。
